where: crates/blaze-keyed/src/kind.rs `kind!` and `tags!` (tags 1 to 15, each once, checked at compile time); crates/blaze-findings/src/kinds.rs
what: Every record kind must be declared and listed in blaze-keyed's one registry, so a new crate with its own kinds (the four findings kinds) cannot add them without editing blaze-keyed, which another lane owns; blaze-findings declares them locally at tags 20 to 23 instead, outside the store's untyped dispatch.
cost: a hand-off: the four kinds move into kind.rs at the next free tags, and the dense tag rule means two lanes adding kinds at once both take tag 16
cause: the registry is a hand-kept dense list in one file, not a set each crate contributes to and one test checks
class: a closed id space allocated by hand in one shared file, so concurrent additions collide or wait
prevention: each crate declares its kinds with a tag range it owns (blaze-keyed's table of ranges per crate), and the store's index is the union, checked for overlap in one test
workaround: declare kinds locally past the registry's end and say so in the module doc; move them in when blaze-keyed is free
